mapper.sql: i.external_id AS id, i.organization_uuid, o.name AS organization_name, i.email, i.role, CASE WHEN i.status = 'pending' AND i.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN 'expired' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.invited_at, i.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM organization_invites i JOIN organizations o ON o.uuid = i.organization_uuid WHERE lower(i.email) = lower(#{email}) AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status = 'pending' AND i.expires_at > clock_timestamp() ORDER BY i.invited_at DESC, i.uuid DESC
SELECT FROM organization_invites i JOIN organizations o ON o.uuid = i.organization_uuid WHERE i.external_id = #{id} AND lower(i.email) = lower(#{email}) FOR UPDATE OF i
SELECT external_id AS id, role FROM users WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND lower(email) = lower(#{email}) AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (external_id, organization_uuid, email, role) VALUES (#{params.ID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.Email}, #{params.Role}) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, lower(email)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
